notes.title: Trading Cards & Points Shop Items
notes.notes:
Added trading cards and backgrounds from the Point Shop.
If you have played the game before, you will get the cards at startup.
We hope you enjoy them.

notes.title: The artbook for the Steam version is now in Korean!
notes.notes:
The Korean translation of the Dark Witch series just won't stop!
What a surprise, now the artbook for the Steam version of Renovation is now in Korean!
The artbook is very rare, as we basically don't translate artbooks.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1196070/_Renovation/

notes.title: Korean language added and bugs fixed
notes.notes:
-Korean was added to the in-game language with the help of volunteers.
-Fixed a bug that made Papelne bigger when the style was set to classic.
-The volume of Sola and Papelne's voices in renovation has been increased.
-The shake has been changed to only when the player is hit.

notes.title: no shake
notes.notes:
If you don't want shake when damage.
→Select Beta and choose "no_shake".
